source: A Night Off design doc pp. 37-40 (Skins and the token spin). Tokens buy skins and nothing else; 50 skins, 10 to save up for and 40 only from the brass wheel in the cloakroom. Skins are cosmetic and seen by everyone; the two jokes are the Constable (the police are confused for 10 s) and the Golden Kidney (still stealable: they take the costume). 'shape' picks the code-drawn costume; colours are top, trousers, hat.
